summary: Verastem furnished an 8-K attaching a presentation for an investor call to review preliminary Phase 1/2 clinical data for its KRAS G12D inhibitor VS-7375 and disclosed a non-binding intent to negotiate a preclinical collaboration with Erasca. No definitive agreement exists; no financial terms, stake, or premium were announced. This is a routine clinical/business development update, not a special situation. The filing contains Regulation FD disclosures and no transformative corporate event.
